cdf_a.method: Gauss-Legendre panels with the grid points as panel edges

evidence_and_moments.method: scipy.integrate.quad over a with b | a integrated analytically

settings.marginal_b_and_cdf_b: Gauss-Legendre over a (panel 0.01, order 8) of the analytic Gaussian b | a

window_mass.method: scipy.integrate.quad over a of the Gaussian b | a probability

grid_mass_physical.note: Trapezoid integral of the stored log_posterior grid versus the exact window probability.

grid_mass_unit.note: Midpoint integral of the stored unit-square target versus 1.

log_z_analytic.note: Closed-form linear-Gaussian log Z versus adaptive quadrature.

log_z_gauss_legendre.note: Independent composite Gauss-Legendre log Z versus adaptive quadrature.

credible_levels.method: credible_thresholds on a 0.01-spaced grid over a in [-6.0, 6.0], b in [-5.0, 5.0]

grid_unit.note: Normalized target L(T(u))/Z on the prior-uniform unit square (spec §3.4); HPD levels refer to unit-square density.

notes.counters: Grid evaluations are display/validation work, not sampler calls; all counters are therefore zero.
notes.log_floor: Display grids store max(log density, log_floor), rounded to 4 decimals; cells at the floor have smaller true values.
notes.reference_only: Independent reference calculation for validation and display. It is never passed to a sampler, proposal construction or training set.

window.note: Fixed display window; the 99.9% HPD region lies inside it. mass_inside is the exact posterior probability of the window.
